explains: src/lib/events.ts has a variable called router, made by createRouter() of the event bus (not Express), and calls router.get("/ping", ...). src/lib/warm.ts calls cache.get("/orders/:id", load) on a module of the repository. Neither is an Express router: an Express router is made by express.Router() or Router() of the express package, and an app by express(); the name of a variable means nothing. No route is claimed for either (GET /ping and GET /orders/{id} are not routes of this service), nothing imports the two files, and nothing else is reached.

must_exclude.why: router is not an Express router
